name: a device without the drive key (a forgotten passphrase) changes nothing; the recovery code gives every file back
description: DEGOO-011 (sync-chaos crypto-keys-and-recovery): Degoo's Top Secret files were lost for good with a forgotten passphrase. Rules I1 and D5: the recovery code made at the drive's creation unwraps the drive key, every encrypted file decrypts again; a device without the key reads nothing and deletes nothing meanwhile.
pending: drive_open joined:false (a device whose keyring lacks the remote's drive key, as after a forgotten passphrase); drive_recover {device} (AzDrive's recovery flow: unwrap the drive key from the recovery wrap with the recovery code drive_create made)
